      "text": "Asks whether there are plans to add a test for an external signer wallet with private keys enabled in a later PR.",

      "clears_with": "answer",

      "author_replies": [

      "author_replies": [],

      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:2901874167",

    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3182035442",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Update the error message so it does not state private keys are disabled when an external signer is used without private keys disabled.",
      "quote": "After the next commit, the associated error here (\"Private keys are disabled for this wallet\") doesn't seem correct if it's an external signer.",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author split the change into its own commit with an updated error message and test",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3194379668"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3194379668",
      "status_by_quote": "Indeed. I also split this change into its own commit 996064c6db85023e0f8aa4f91277ac494821292d and added a test."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3857009395",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Toggling external_signer flag on an existing wallet leaves descriptor ScriptPubKeyMans out of sync, causing wallet operations like display address and send to fail until reloaded.",
      "quote": "The SPKM subclass is chosen when it's constructed, and toggling doesn't rebuild the existing ones, so after unloadwallet/loadwallet, with nothing else changed, both work.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "reloading the wallet on toggle keeps SPKMs in sync; no further objection",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3863277995",
        "rc:3863278741"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3863277995",
      "status_by_quote": "it's actually easier to just have the RPC automatically reload the whole wallet for this flag. So I went with that."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3857009403",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Toggling external_signer flag off leaves leftover external signer SPKMs, causing subsequent spends to abort in FillPSBT without a reload.",
      "quote": "Imported a descriptor with the flag on, turned the flag off, imported another one, and without reloading I can't spend from either.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "fixed by the automatic reload on flag toggle",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3863278741"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3863278741",
      "status_by_quote": "That should be fixed now, thanks to the reload."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3857009408",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Setting external_signer flag on a build without external signer support bricks the wallet from loading on that binary.",
      "quote": "On a build with -DENABLE_EXTERNAL_SIGNER=OFF I set the flag on an ordinary wallet and it no longer loads on that binary, not even after a restart",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "added compile guard for ENABLE_EXTERNAL_SIGNER; no further objection",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3863279258"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3863279258",
      "status_by_quote": "Added a guard for completeness."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3876752265",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "In an external signer wallet with private keys enabled, FillPSBT attempts to sign hot key UTXOs using the hardware signer and fails.",
      "quote": "a descriptor holding a hot key also gets an ExternalSignerScriptPubKeyMan here, and at LoadDescriptorScriptPubKeyMan. Its FillPSBT() goes straight to the device when sign=true and never falls back.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer confirmed the fix on Ledger Flex",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5449642921",
        "rc:3878680467"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3883522238",
      "status_by_quote": "Confirmed fixed on a Ledger Flex, thanks."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3883522238",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "What is the intended wallet layout for a multisig where one cosigner is an external signer and another is a hot key, if mixing hot and cold descriptors in one wallet is discouraged?",
      "quote": "If mixing hot and cold in one wallet isn't encouraged, what's the intended layout for a multisig where one cosigner is an external signer and another is a hot key, one wallet per key?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained the descriptor setup and key export workflow",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3893028331"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3893028331",
      "status_by_quote": "Ideally there's a single multisig descriptor for which the wallet has one key, e.g. musig2(core_xprv, ledger_xpub)."
    }

claims.text: Asks whether there are plans to add a test for an external signer wallet with private keys enabled in a later PR.

claims.text: Add a functional test explicitly enabling private keys upon external signer wallet creation.

claims.status_note: naiyoma seconded the suggestion and author later added test coverage

claims.text: Update the error message so it does not state private keys are disabled when an external signer is used without private keys disabled.
claims.quote: After the next commit, the associated error here ("Private keys are disabled for this wallet") doesn't seem correct if it's an external signer.

claims.text: Toggling external_signer flag on an existing wallet leaves descriptor ScriptPubKeyMans out of sync, causing wallet operations like display address and send to fail until reloaded.

claims.status_note: reloading the wallet on toggle keeps SPKMs in sync; no further objection

claims.text: Toggling external_signer flag off leaves leftover external signer SPKMs, causing subsequent spends to abort in FillPSBT without a reload.

claims.status_note: reviewer confirmed the fix on Ledger Flex
claims.status_by_quote: Confirmed fixed on a Ledger Flex, thanks.

claims.text: What is the intended wallet layout for a multisig where one cosigner is an external signer and another is a hot key, if mixing hot and cold descriptors in one wallet is discouraged?

claims.status_note: author explained the descriptor setup and key export workflow
claims.status_by_quote: Ideally there's a single multisig descriptor for which the wallet has one key, e.g. musig2(core_xprv, ledger_xpub).

support.reason: Agree with the intent to relax these constraints for external signer wallets.
Built and ran successfully all tests. Qt UX tested on regtest with mock signer
Reviewed commits and tested createwallet on bitcoin-qt and on cli
Built and ran the wallet and signer tests.
This greatly helps unblock using external signers and hot keys in the same wallet for a multisig setup
This PR also reduces repeated external signer calls: on master one signing can ask the device once per descriptor.
